title: Policy bundle manifest (C7)
description: manifest.json at the root of policies-<revision>.tar.gz. A main bundle also contains schema.cedarschema, policies/**/*.cedar and entities/static.json. An overrides bundle contains only manifest.json and policies/**/*.cedar with forbid rules: schema and static entities always come from the main bundle, and an overrides archive with any other entry or any permit policy is rejected (CC-028). Revisions are monotonic per channel (main and overrides separately). The signature policies-<revision>.tar.gz.sig is a raw 64-byte Ed25519 signature over the exact bytes of the .tar.gz file; main and overrides use different keys.

gitSha.description: Full commit sha of mcp-policies; its first 7 characters equal the sha part of revision.

schemaVersion.description: Version of mcp-contracts whose cedar/mcp.cedarschema is shipped as schema.cedarschema.
